pixel_coords: x right, y down, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.motion: static (mean abs RGB diff of the upper image between frame 0 and frame 70 = 0.44/765; no shift)
camera.view: frontal, roughly orthographic-looking view of a gabled house facade; motion of the man is parallel to the facade, i.e. in a plane facing the camera
camera.horizon_or_vanishing: no usable vanishing points; facade verticals and horizontals are image-aligned. Deck front edge visible at y ~ 900-960.

moving_objects.name: man
moving_objects.description: the only moving object: an adult man (light grey T-shirt, dark blue jeans, dark shoes, face blurred) walking from left to right along the porch in front of the house
moving_objects.reference_point: pelvis_x_smooth, pelvis_y_smooth (recommended): estimated hip point = horizontal mid-point of the mask on the row 47% of bbox height above the bbox bottom, smoothed with a 7-frame local quadratic. Raw pelvis_x/pelvis_y (jittery +-3 px from hands at hip level) and centroid_x/y (mask centroid, smooth) are also given.

motion_summary_px.direction: +x (left to right), essentially horizontal; pelvis_y stays 761-777
motion_summary_px.feet_bottom_y_unoccluded: 869-879 (dark shoe soles on dark deck, +-5 px)

size_px.bbox_height_note: head top to lowest foot; largest (~222-223) mid-stride frames 12-20; 209-212 when the mask misses part of the shoe soles; frames 47-52 feet hidden by the left lounge chair (198-205, not valid heights)
size_px.bbox_width_note: varies with stride: ~52-56 legs together, ~108-114 at full stride

moving_objects.occlusion: frames 47-52: feet/lower legs hidden behind the left lounge chair (occluded=1 in the csv). Otherwise fully visible (at frame 0 he is just right of the potted plant: bbox x0 = 325 vs pot x1 = 323).
moving_objects.mean_pelvis_step_px_per_frame: about 5.5 px/frame (363.5 -> 750.0 over 70 frames); per-frame steps vary 3-8.6 px with gait
